notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable embedded temporal-role development slice to exact C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It records regulation/constrained enable and disable services, Query Lookahead, and the two completion callbacks. The traced regressions include default-region and explicit-source regional timestamped interactions plus an explicit-source regional timestamped object update that remain queued across Time Constrained disable/re-enable and a normal-interaction case that exercises Disable Time Regulation, callback-gated re-enable, and the second Time Regulation Enabled callback while a separate Request Retraction contract records the bounded live-designator lifetime. The Lab exports no higher-level implementation mapping for these surfaces, so this checks only declaration, declared exception set, source symbol, and Catch2 selector agreement. It is not a catalog, JUnit result, protected-review result, production package claim, or conformance claim.
